title: File invoice attachments from Gmail in Google Drive
description: Every evening, searches Gmail for messages with PDF invoices, names each file by date and sender domain and files it in a Drive folder of its own. With the drive.file scope SubKit only sees folders it created itself, so the first run creates the folder by name and later runs find it.
prerequisites: Gmail connector signed in to the mailbox that receives the invoices
Google Drive connector signed in with the drive.file scope
A name for the Drive folder SubKit creates for the invoices on its first run
author: subkit-builtin

workflow.name: invoice-attachments-to-drive
workflow.description: Files PDF invoice attachments from Gmail in a Drive folder SubKit creates and finds by name, named date_sender_filename.

query.description: Gmail search that finds the invoice mails, e.g. has:attachment filename:pdf subject:invoice newer_than:1d

folder_name.description: Name of the Drive folder SubKit creates on the first run and finds again later

steps.expression: const fetched = Array.isArray(input.scope.fetch_message && input.scope.fetch_message.data) ? input.scope.fetch_message.data : []; const attachments = []; const walk = (part, msg, day, sender) => { if (!part) return; if (part.body && part.body.attachmentId && /\.pdf$/i.test(part.filename || '')) { attachments.push({ message_id: msg.id, attachment_id: part.body.attachmentId, file_name: day + '_' + sender + '_' + part.filename }); } (part.parts || []).forEach((child) => walk(child, msg, day, sender)); }; for (const entry of fetched) { const msg = entry && entry.fetch_message && entry.fetch_message.data ? entry.fetch_message.data : entry; if (!msg || !msg.payload) continue; const from = ((msg.payload.headers || []).find((h) => String(h.name).toLowerCase() === 'from') || { value: '' }).value; const domain = (String(from).match(/@([a-z0-9.-]+)/i) || [null, 'unknown'])[1].toLowerCase(); const day = new Date(Number(msg.internalDate || 0)).toISOString().slice(0, 10); walk(msg.payload, msg, day, domain); } return { message_count: fetched.length, attachments };

const found = ((input.scope.find_folder.data || {}).files || [])[0]; const made = input.scope.create_folder && input.scope.create_folder.data; const id = found ? found.id : made && made.id; if (!id) throw new Error('no Drive folder named ' + input.input.folder_name + ' could be found or created'); return { id, created: !found };

const picked = input.scope.pick_attachments.data.attachments; const downloads = Array.isArray(input.scope.download_attachment && input.scope.download_attachment.data) ? input.scope.download_attachment.data : []; const boundary = 'subkit-upload'; const uploads = picked.map((attachment, index) => { const entry = downloads[index]; const file = entry && entry.download_attachment && entry.download_attachment.data ? entry.download_attachment.data : entry; const data = String((file && file.data) || '').replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'); const meta = JSON.stringify({ name: attachment.file_name, parents: [input.scope.folder.data.id] }); const body = '--' + boundary + '
Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8

' + meta + '
--' + boundary + '
Content-Type: application/pdf
Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64

' + data + '
--' + boundary + '--'; return { file_name: attachment.file_name, body }; }); return { uploads };

const saved = Array.isArray(input.scope.upload_file && input.scope.upload_file.data) ? input.scope.upload_file.data : []; return { folder_id: input.scope.folder.data.id, messages_scanned: input.scope.pick_attachments.data.message_count, files_saved: saved.length, file_names: input.scope.build_uploads.data.uploads.map((u) => u.file_name) };

title: Email a daily Google Analytics report
description: Every morning, reads yesterday's users, sessions, page views and top pages from Google Analytics 4 and sends them as one mail.
prerequisites: Google Analytics 4 connector signed in to an account with Viewer access to the property
Gmail connector signed in to the sending mailbox
The numeric GA4 property id
author: subkit-builtin

workflow.name: daily-analytics-report
workflow.description: Mails yesterday's Google Analytics 4 totals and top pages every morning.

sender.description: Address of the Gmail mailbox that sends it

steps.expression:
const totals = input.scope.totals.data || {}; const metric = (name) => { const headers = totals.metricHeaders || []; const index = headers.findIndex((h) => h.name === name); const row = (totals.rows || [])[0]; return index >= 0 && row ? Number(row.metricValues[index].value) : 0; }; const pages = ((input.scope.top_pages.data || {}).rows || []).map((row) => ({ path: row.dimensionValues[0].value, views: Number(row.metricValues[0].value) })); const active_users = metric('activeUsers'); const sessions = metric('sessions'); const page_views = metric('screenPageViews'); const rows = pages.map((p) => '' + p.path + '' + p.views + '').join(''); const html = '

Daily analytics report

Yesterday: ' + active_users + ' active users, ' + sessions + ' sessions, ' + page_views + ' page views.

' + rows + '
PageViews
'; const mail = sk.buildMimeMessage({ from: input.input.sender, to: input.input.recipient, subject: 'Daily analytics report', html }); return { active_users, sessions, page_views, top_page: pages.length ? pages[0].path : null, raw: mail.raw };
const r = input.scope.build_report.data; return { active_users: r.active_users, sessions: r.sessions, page_views: r.page_views, top_page: r.top_page, message_id: input.scope.send_report.data.id };

title: Grant access after a paid Stripe checkout
description: When Stripe reports a completed checkout (the Stripe signature is checked before the workflow runs), confirms the payment with Stripe, grants the buyer access in your own system and sends a welcome mail.
prerequisites: Stripe connector with a restricted key that can read checkout sessions
Stripe webhook for checkout.session.completed pointed at this workflow, with its signing secret
HTTP connector for your own access API that accepts POST /access/grants
Gmail connector signed in to the sending mailbox
Checkout sessions carry metadata.access_group with the group to grant
author: subkit-builtin

workflow.name: payment-grants-access
workflow.description: Stripe checkout.session.completed → payment confirmed with Stripe → access granted → welcome mail.

steps.expression: return { sender: 'team@example.com', welcome_subject: 'Welcome aboard' };

const raw = input.input; let parsed = raw; if (typeof raw === 'string') { try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { parsed = {}; } } parsed = parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {}; const evt = parsed.body && typeof parsed.body === 'object' ? parsed.body : parsed; if (evt.type !== 'checkout.session.completed') return { skip: true, event_type: evt.type || 'unknown' }; const session = (evt.data && evt.data.object) || {}; const email = String((session.customer_details && session.customer_details.email) || session.customer_email || '').trim(); const group = String((session.metadata && session.metadata.access_group) || '').trim(); const missing = []; if (!session.id) missing.push('session id'); if (!email) missing.push('customer email'); if (!group) missing.push('metadata.access_group'); if (missing.length) throw new Error('stripe event ' + (evt.id || 'unknown') + ' is missing: ' + missing.join(', ')); return { skip: false, event_id: evt.id || null, session_id: session.id, email, group };
const session = input.scope.verify_payment.data || {}; return { grant: session.payment_status === 'paid' };

const p = input.scope.parse_event.data; const s = input.scope.settings.data; const text = 'Welcome! Your payment went through and your access to ' + p.group + ' is active. Sign in with ' + p.email + '.'; const mail = sk.buildMimeMessage({ from: s.sender, to: p.email, subject: s.welcome_subject, text }); return { raw: mail.raw };

const p = input.scope.parse_event.data; if (p.skip) return { status: 'skipped', event_type: p.event_type }; const verdict = input.scope.decide && input.scope.decide.data; if (!verdict || !verdict.grant) return { status: 'not_paid', email: p.email, group: p.group }; const sent = input.scope.send_welcome && input.scope.send_welcome.data; return { status: 'granted', email: p.email, group: p.group, message_id: sent ? sent.id : null };

title: Check incoming events and post the important ones to Slack
description: Receives signed events from any system by webhook, keeps only those at or above the level you choose and posts them into one Slack channel. Each request must carry an HMAC-SHA256 signature of its raw body made with the webhook's secret (header X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=<hex>); unsigned or wrongly signed requests are refused before the workflow runs.
prerequisites: Slack connector with a bot token that has chat:write and is a member of the channel

The sending system posts JSON with level, title and detail to this workflow's webhook address and signs each request with the webhook secret (X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>)
author: subkit-builtin

workflow.name: webhook-to-slack
workflow.description: Posts signed incoming events at or above a minimum level into one Slack channel.

steps.expression: return { channel: '#alerts', min_level: 'error' };

const raw = input.input; let parsed = raw; if (typeof raw === 'string') { try { parsed = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { parsed = {}; } } parsed = parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : {}; const evt = parsed.body && typeof parsed.body === 'object' ? parsed.body : parsed; const levels = ['debug', 'info', 'warning', 'error', 'critical']; const level = levels.includes(String(evt.level).toLowerCase()) ? String(evt.level).toLowerCase() : 'info'; const important = levels.indexOf(level) >= levels.indexOf(input.scope.settings.data.min_level); const title = String(evt.title || 'Event without title').slice(0, 200); const detail = String(evt.detail || '').slice(0, 1000); return { important, level, text: '[' + level.toUpperCase() + '] ' + title + (detail ? ' — ' + detail : '') };

const checked = input.scope.check_event.data; const posted = input.scope.post_message && input.scope.post_message.data; return { important: checked.important, level: checked.level, posted: Boolean(posted && posted.ok), slack_ts: posted && posted.ts ? posted.ts : null };

title: Email a weekly digest of runs and failures
description: Every Friday afternoon, counts this installation's workflow runs of the week, lists the failed ones and sends the digest as one mail.
prerequisites: HTTP connector for this SubKit installation's API with an API key that can read executions and stats
Gmail connector signed in to the sending mailbox
author: subkit-builtin

workflow.name: weekly-run-digest
workflow.description: Mails a weekly digest of workflow runs and the failed ones.

sender.description: Address of the Gmail mailbox that sends it

steps.expression: const end = sk.now(); return { from: new Date(end - 7 * 86400000).toISOString(), to: new Date(end).toISOString() };

const totals = ((input.scope.run_stats.data || {}).totals || {}).executions || { count: 0, by_status: {} }; const failed = (input.scope.failed_runs.data || {}).items || []; const total_runs = Number(totals.count || 0); const failed_runs = Number((totals.by_status || {}).failed || 0) + Number((totals.by_status || {}).timed_out || 0); const rows = failed.map((run) => '
  • ' + (run.workflow_name || 'workflow') + ': ' + (run.error_code || run.status) + '
    • ').join(''); const html = '

    Weekly run digest

    ' + total_runs + ' runs, ' + failed_runs + ' failed.

    ' + (rows ? '
      ' + rows + '
    ' : '

    No failures this week.

    '); const mail = sk.buildMimeMessage({ from: input.input.sender, to: input.input.recipient, subject: 'Weekly run digest', html }); return { total_runs, failed_runs, raw: mail.raw };
const d = input.scope.build_digest.data; return { total_runs: d.total_runs, failed_runs: d.failed_runs, message_id: input.scope.send_digest.data.id };

author: subkit-builtin
title: Report a problem with SubKit to the maintainer
description: Sends a problem report to the central SubKit support inbox after you confirm it. The title and description are yours, with tokens, keys, passwords and e-mail addresses removed on a best-effort basis; the tenant and the reporting person come from your sign-in, never from the input. Needs only the subkit-support connector. Returns the ticket number and status.
prerequisites: subkit-support connector with the reporter key of this installation and the approved external write
A signed-in person starts the run; webhooks and schedules cannot file a report

Pass the cursor of the previous page to read the next one. The report list is bound to the signed-in person by the engine; nothing is stored locally.

workflow.name: support-list-issues
workflow.description: Lists the signed-in person's reports in the central SubKit support inbox.

steps.expression: const page = (input.scope.list_more && input.scope.list_more.data) || (input.scope.list_first && input.scope.list_first.data) || {}; const items = Array.isArray(page.items) ? page.items : []; const reports = items.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, number: r.number, title: r.title, status: r.status, public_note: r.public_note, version: r.version, created_at: r.created_at, updated_at: r.updated_at })); return { count: reports.length, reports, next_cursor: typeof page.next_cursor === 'string' && page.next_cursor ? page.next_cursor : null };

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page; leave out for the first page

author: subkit-builtin
title: Withdraw one of my SubKit problem reports
description: Withdraws one of your own reports in the central SubKit support inbox. The report is first read for the signed-in person only, then withdrawn at the version just read. A report that is missing or belongs to someone else (404) ends with withdrawn:false and reason not_found, and nothing is written; any other read failure fails the run. A report that is already resolved or closed as wont-fix cannot be withdrawn.
prerequisites: subkit-support connector with the reporter key of this installation and the approved external write
The id of the report from the report list

workflow.name: support-withdraw-issue
workflow.description: Withdraws one of the signed-in person's reports in the central SubKit support inbox.

report_id.description: Id of the report to withdraw, from the report list

steps.expression: const read = input.scope.get_report || {}; const readData = read.data; if (!readData || readData.version === undefined || readData.version === null) { if (read.error && read.error.upstream_status === 404) return { withdrawn: false, reason: 'not_found' }; throw new Error('the report could not be read (' + ((read.error && read.error.upstream_status) || 'no response') + '), nothing was withdrawn'); } const done = (input.scope.withdraw_report && input.scope.withdraw_report.data) || {}; return { withdrawn: true, number: done.number, id: done.id, status: done.status, withdrawn_at: done.withdrawn_at };
